prompt.text:
Implement a pure reducer for navigating a numbered window. Export `WindowState`, `WindowCommand`, `WindowResult`, and `updateWindow(state, command)`. State contains `totalItems`, `pageSize`, and one-based `page`. Commands are `{ type: "page"; page: number }` and `{ type: "pageSize"; pageSize: number }`. All state numbers and command numbers must be safe integers; `totalItems` may be zero, while page sizes and requested pages must be positive. Malformed state or command values throw `TypeError`. A valid page command changes the page only when it is at most `max(1, ceil(totalItems/pageSize))`. An out-of-range page leaves state unchanged and returns warning `"Page is out of range"`. Changing page size is allowed only to 10, 25, 50, or 100 and resets the page to 1; an unsupported size leaves state unchanged with warning `"Unsupported page size"`. The result also contains inclusive one-based `rangeStart` and `rangeEnd`; both are zero when there are no items. For successful commands warning is `null`. Return a new state object and never mutate the input. Provide one complete TypeScript source file.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
